app.wallpapercat.name: Wallpaper Cat
app.wallpapercat.head-sub: The single place to manage wallpapers
app.wallpapercat.tier-not-current: This is not the active tier; changes apply once you switch to it
app.wallpapercat.boot-only-static: The boot screen only takes static wallpapers. Apply videos and interactive packs to the desktop.
app.wallpapercat.delete-body: Delete “{v1}”? The file is removed from the wallpaper library for good.
app.wallpapercat.deleted-switched: Deleted {v1} and fell back to the default wallpaper
app.wallpapercat.empty-mine: No wallpapers of your own yet
app.wallpapercat.empty-mine-hint: png / jpg / webp / gif and mp4 / webm videos are supported; zip an interactive pack to import it
app.wallpapercat.upload-hint: Video wallpapers may carry sound: playback starts muted and unmutes after the first click on the desktop (browser autoplay policy). An interactive pack needs index.html, or a wallpaper.json that declares its entry.
app.wallpapercat.system-hint: Built-in wallpapers ship with the program; built-in engines are local canvas animations that use no network and no disk.
app.wallpapercat.engines-hint: Engine wallpapers follow the pointer; you can switch or slow them down anytime.
app.wallpapercat.no-dynamic: No dynamic wallpaper yet — upload a video or import an interactive pack first
app.wallpapercat.video-audio-hint: Browsers need a user gesture before audio; it takes effect after the first click on the desktop
app.wallpapercat.video-pause-hidden-hint: Saves power: no decoding while the tab is in the background
app.wallpapercat.web-interact-hint: Broadcast via postMessage; desktop clicks still work
app.wallpapercat.web-capture-hint: The wallpaper briefly covers the desktop to take clicks; press Esc or wait 4s
app.wallpapercat.web-note: An interactive wallpaper runs its scripts inside its own sandbox and cannot read the host session token. Only import packs you trust.
app.wallpapercat.web-protocol: Pointer protocol: the host posts {__qxWall:1,type:'pointer',x,y,down} to the embedded page.
app.wallpapercat.engine-hint: Engines draw inside the host page, so pointer and theme changes apply immediately.
app.wallpapercat.rotate-on-hint: Switch the desktop wallpaper on an interval (desktop only, current theme tier)
app.wallpapercat.rotate-pool-hint: Uncheck an entry to exclude it; unchecking everything means every entry.
app.wallpapercat.engine.stardust.desc: Particles pulled by the pointer, bursting on click
app.wallpapercat.engine.rain.desc: Slanted rain and water traces; ripples follow the pointer
